title: [Feature]: only download browsers that are used
summary: ### 🚀 Feature Request The current experience is: - `Playwright.create()` calls `Driver.ensureDriverInstalled`, which installs all browsers The net effect is that you are downloading all browsers including the ones you don't need, which is not only a waste of time/space/bandwidth, but also will crash if for instance "Playwright does not support chromium on ubuntu20.04-x64" (my exact case). But I don't use Chromium. Instead, the current experience should be: - `Playwright.firefox()` checks for / installs Firefox ### Example _No response_ ### Motivation I know there is a workaround, which is to install the browsers manually via mvn, and use `PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD`. But that's what it is: a workaround, which is a bit tedious, and should not be necessary. The experience should be great by default.

title: Don’t Download This App .. Very frustrating and disappointing experience
summary: ### What happened? Very disappointing experience with this app. It asks me to sign in, even though signing in is apparently not required just to play music. However, after that, it still requires the account to have an active paid Premium subscription! So what is the actual purpose of the app if I have to pay for Premium just to use its basic features? This makes the free version feel almost completely useless. The requirements and limitations should be made clear from the beginning instead of asking users to sign in and then blocking the main functionality behind a paid subscription. Overall, a very frustrating and disappointing experience. ### App version 0.5.1 ### Platform Windows ### OS version / distro _No response_ ### Account state Signed in (Free) ### Logs / screenshots
